evidence.policy: implemented requires every resolvable test reference and an empty remaining list; partial names resolvable tests and what they leave unpinned; uncovered names no test and gives the reason

items.title: Generation-gate FIFO, cancellation transfer, holder failure, and deterministic stress
Dedicated owned Qwen3 runtime target with Metal resources
Requested learned tokenizer and speaker components require real weights
Clone artifact atomic publication, tensor round trip, integrity, and mode requirements
Official Qwen speaker-feature parity and finite canonical embeddings
Clone prompt memory and disk identities include model-artifact, runtime, and speaker-feature contracts
Typed telemetry v8 memory evidence, legacy compatibility, privacy, disabled work, and measured overhead
Streaming bounded retention, scheduling, cancellation, and final barrier
Seeded Metal decoder partition invariance, reset isolation, and timing parity
Atomic readable frame-accurate final WAV publication
Streamed takes feed text at one token per codec frame, so a long segment runs out of script and the talker sees only tts_pad (D1)
items.reason: Open by decision: the 2026-10-16 RF-18 screen did not adopt full-text conditioning, and the Consistent long-form stall is a 3.0 known limitation; no test pins the production layout (ER-03).

items.title: The Mimi clone-reference encoder applies traditional RoPE to rotate_half weights
items.reason: Open: the encoder still builds RoPE(traditional: true), and no parity fixture against the official tokenizer exists; the fix ships with G-03's version bump (ER-04, parity fixtures ER-01).

items.title: The speech-tokenizer decoder never applies its 72-frame window; its KV grows for the whole take
items.reason: Open: PA-16 (parked) owns the window, the bounded KV and a parity fixture against the official 300/25 decode.

items.title: Streamed clones decode from a cold decoder without reference history
items.reason: Open: fixed together with A-26's primed decoder history (ER-04).

items.title: A talker KV window would evict the unspoken script in the streaming text layout (latent; the refuter rated it S3)
items.reason: Open and latent: production sets no talker window, and nothing refuses one with the streaming layout (ER-09).

items.title: EOS is re-inserted into the sampled logits (D2), which can truncate a take
items.reason: Open: the RF-18 follow-up screen's EOS arms (C4, E4) decide D2; E4 has not run (ER-05).

items.title: Custom voices under Auto fall back to English and its diction instruction (D6)
items.reason: Open by design (C-33) until ER-05 decides it by screen.

items.title: The tokenizer encoder keeps its KV, and a longer input concatenates onto the stale buffer (MEM-1)
items.reason: Open: MEM-1 (ER-06).

items.title: ICA-06, ICA-15 and RF-06 (Chinese silences) share A-01's streaming-text mechanism
items.reason: Open: re-measured under ER-03 once the text-conditioning decision changes.

items.title: Proactive load, prime and prompt prebuilds keep submitting GPU work after the app leaves the foreground (BG-1)
remaining: The cancellation check before marking (path d) is verified by review only: no test drives the adapter's execution body without a loaded model.
A proactive load already running still finishes (B-04).
Device proof (smoke --scenario background-warmup): the paired iPhone run waits for the next announced window.

items.title: A cancelled Mac warm unloads the model, then the cancelled-take path publishes .loaded with nothing resident
items.reason: Open (ER-06). The suite stayed green because ResidentLoadCoordinator(warmRequests: .cancel) throws in qwen3Capabilities, before the warm body and its catch run.

items.title: Quitting the Mac app mid-take runs MLX's static destructors under live GPU work
items.reason: Open: no applicationShouldTerminate and no shutdown barrier on the Mac (ER-02).

items.title: Cancel and memory relief wait out load, warm, trust hashing and marking (CONC-1)
items.reason: Open: no cooperative checkpoints inside the loader, warm or hashing, and the load-epoch veto has no production trigger (ER-02).

items.title: Mac unloads keep the process-global Qwen3 caches, also at the critical band (E2-01)
items.reason: Open (ER-06).

items.title: No engine-side deletion lease; the deletion gate trusts a load state B-02 can make stale
items.reason: Open: PA-33 (parked).

items.title: Saved-voice enrollment accepts a partial recognition transcript, so ICL takes run on a truncated ref_text
items.reason: Open: enrollment never applies the verifier's edge-coverage rule (ER-04).

items.title: Use audio only on a saved voice with a transcript still conditions on the stored transcript
items.reason: Open: needs three explicit transcript request states (ER-04).

items.title: Nothing versions the encoder implementation, so saved voices keep A-02's wrong codes after the RoPE fix
items.reason: Open: the speaker-feature version now ends with the MLX build (F-06), but no encoder version or golden-codes test exists; ships with A-02 (ER-04).

items.title: Mac History's Save to Saved Voices enrolls the requested script as a Clone take's transcript
items.reason: Open (ER-04).

items.title: iPhone import trusts a neighbouring .txt as a reviewed transcript
items.reason: Open (ER-04).

items.title: Stereo and multichannel references are mixed to mono implicitly and untested
items.reason: Open: lands after G-13's audio-preparation version (ER-04).

items.title: References end abruptly with no trim or fade before 0.5 s of padding (the onset-echo trigger)
items.reason: Open: lands after G-13's audio-preparation version (ER-04).

items.title: Clone-artifact adoption, persistence and codec replay ran GPU validation outside any MLX error scope
remaining: No test forces an MLX failure through persistCloneArtifact or replayCodecTrace.
Nothing asserts that the speaker-embedding finite check runs on the CPU stream; its test passes on the GPU stream too.

items.title: The MLX refresh changes every seeded take (inverse-CDF categorical); accepted with a release-note line, and seeded draws are pinned
Reading an array back after a captured allocation failure copied from an unfilled buffer
remaining: The probe and the generation completion are tested; no test drives a failure through the talker-loop or decoder-chunk readbacks, so dropping the probe at one of them stays green.

items.title: Two quick iPhone installs ran at once and wedged both
remaining: The admission rules are pinned; that IOSModelDownloadCoordinator takes both claims before its first await is not: the coordinator is in no unit-test target.
Device proof (RF-15's onboarding and download row): the paired iPhone run waits for the next announced window.

items.title: A failed file was recorded as a user cancel: the row froze at Cancelling and the next launch deleted the staging
remaining: The mapping, run-end and restore rules are pinned; IOSModelDownloadCoordinator, which applies them, is in no unit-test target.
Device proof: the paired iPhone run waits for the next announced window.

items.title: Staged files the current plan does not list are hard-linked into the installed model after a catalog layout change
items.reason: Open, partly mitigated: a launch that finds a request's artifact gone now discards its staging (64ff7f86, applied in the untested coordinator), but staging is still keyed by model and unlisted files are still linked; lands before any catalog layout change (ER-10).

items.title: About 60 s single takes drift into silences of 2 s or more late in the take; long-form fails in ordinary use
items.reason: Open by decision: a 3.0 known limitation naming Consistent; the RF-18 follow-up screen (subtalker C1 passing, budget C2 failing, EOS arms pending) decides the fix, and the iOS long-form smoke is the device proof.

items.title: The planner fills every segment to the 300-unit ceiling (CJK segments of about 70-78 s)
items.reason: Open: the follow-up screen's 200-unit arm (C2) failed its rule on 2026-10-17; planner v3 (ER-03).

items.title: The iPhone long-form smoke was not hermetic: it inherited the phone's variation
items.reason: Fixed in the smoke itself (6efc4f8a pins Expressive and restores it), which runs only on the paired iPhone; no deterministic test fails if the pin is removed.

items.title: A symbol-only paragraph becomes its own segment, and the project fails on every Resume (the refuter rated it S3)
items.reason: Open: planner v3 merges unspeakable segments (ER-03).

items.title: The per-sample silence floor sits at the codec noise floor, so dropout verdicts are unstable
items.reason: Open: ER-11, calibrated with QC v2's human controls.
